detail_totals.schedule: Schedules of Cash Disbursements by Department - General Fund

notes: Modified cash basis school district. Governmental lines come from the Total Governmental Funds column (p6), which already eliminates 930,000 of interfund transfers (General Fund to Depreciation 900,000 hidden in Instruction 45,000, Pupil transportation 100,000, Building improvements 755,000; General to Activity 30,000), so transfers_in/out are null at top level. The General Fund detail keeps the printed lines, adds contra lines and signed other financing items for the hidden transfers (the 45,000 and 100,000 lines are not identifiable within their groups). General Fund expenditure detail total 5,382,108 includes the 930,000 transfers (900,000 + printed 30,000 line); the 755,000 Building improvements line and its contra net to zero. The Transfer to Activity and Nutrition Funds 30,000 matches Activity Fund transfer in 30,000 (p5/p6); no transfer shown into Nutrition. Total-column Other 8,026 split into General Fund rental income 6,119 and other non-revenue 1,907 using the General Fund schedule (p9). State categorical and federal programs placed in instruction (review). Detail: General Fund revenue from the budget schedule p9; General Fund disbursements from the by-department schedule pp13-16 (more detailed, so the budget schedule's disbursement lines are not repeated). Depreciation, Bond and Building fund budget schedules recorded in full. Bond Fund schedule property tax 192,322, carline 11, pro-rate 510 differ by 1 from the p5 statement (192,321, 12, 511); schedule figures recorded as printed there. No schedule for Activity Fund or the Nutrition Fund. Nutrition Fund (business-type) from p8: no single total printed, so reported receipts = operating 206,973 + nonoperating 79. Balance sheet is the Total column of the Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1), which includes the Nutrition Fund's 59,069 cash; top-level ending_cash 4,918,058 is governmental funds only (p4). Beginning cash 4,003,718 = governmental fund balances Aug 31 2024 (p6). Read pages 1-16 of 16
